BETA Close X Currys Plc has purchased and cancelled a total of 1,108,441 ordinary shares between August 18 and August 24, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buy-back program. The average price paid per share during this period was approximately 152.49 pence. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares will be 1,084,453,172.
